thread:
Emma Chen: Heads up — Nimbus Health private deployment invoice looks off. Platform fee line shows $27,500 but contract monthly platform fee is $20,000; there's also a support tier proration. attaching INV-2026-04-21 in case it's helpful. can someone from billing confirm the true-up calculation?

Raj Patel: looking now. did they add extra reserved nodes mid-billing period or is this quantization add-on?

Emma Chen: they added 4 GPUs on Apr 6 for a burst pool, contract start was Mar 1. support upgraded from Standard to Premium on Apr 10. invoice covers Mar 1–Apr 30.

Raj Patel: ok — that explains it. platform fee true-up = pro-rata for extra reserved capacity + monthly base. rough calc: base $20,000 + (4 nodes * $1,500/node * (25/60 days)) = $20,000 + (6000 * 0.4167) ≈ $22,500. support tier bump proration: Premium is $6k/mo vs Standard $2k/mo -> delta $4k * (21/60) ≈ $1,400. rounding/taxes + usage add-ons could be the remainder.

Raj Patel: pulling the invoice now and matching line items. sending quick snippet: ```
# true-up calc
base_month = 20000
extra_nodes = 4
node_price_month = 1500
billing_period_days = 60
extra_days = 25  # Apr 6 to Apr 30 inclusive ~25 days
support_delta = 4000
support_days = 21  # Apr 10 to Apr 30
true_up = base_month + (extra_nodes * node_price_month * (extra_days / billing_period_days)) + (support_delta * (support_days / billing_period_days))
```

invoicing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-04-21 uploaded to billing bucket by billing@redwood.com — total_due: $27,512.34; doc: https://s3.redwood/internal/invoices/INV-2026-04-21.pdf

Lisa Gomez: thanks Raj. quick Q — customer is requesting a one-time goodwill credit for the rounding/taxes ($1,012.34). any objections? they'll cite the upgrade being last-minute.

Raj Patel: breakdown I see: true_up calc ~24,900 + usage tokens/embeddings ~1,500 + tax ~1,112 = 27,512.34. the "mismatch" is mostly usage. we can offer a partial credit but we should confirm usage lines with infra billing first.

Emma Chen: customer facing PS says they only saw spike in GPU hours for two days due to testing; they want the support proration honored but are pushing back on the platform nodes charge.

Jordan Kline: finance POV: we can approve a one-time credit up to $1,000 for goodwill without exec sign-off. >$1k needs a manager sign-off. please route the approval request with final reconciliation numbers.

Raj Patel: I'll reconcile usage lines and attach a short ledger. plan: confirm node-hours and embeddings usage, then propose either a $750 credit (covering testing noise) or full $1,012.34 if infra validates the anomaly. ETA EOD.

Lisa Gomez: tagging @Jordan Kline for visibility. if Raj recommends >$1k we'll need you to sign off. otherwise I can issue the credit and update the invoice in NetSuite.

Jordan Kline: noted. if it's just the two-day test spike and customer wasn't malicious, lean toward the $1,012.34 credit and mark as one-time courtesy. I'll sign after Raj posts reconciliation.

invoicing-bot: Payment status for INV-2026-04-21: pending. Reminder scheduled in 7 days.

Raj Patel: reconciliation done — attaching ledger snippet below; embeddings spike aligns with their test window but GPU hours are billed as reserved nodes (they kept nodes allocated). Summary: suggested credit = $1,012.34.

Raj Patel: final ask: @Jordan Kline can you approve the $1,012.34 one-time credit so Lisa can adjust and reissue the invoice?

Jordan Kline: approved. please proceed, Lisa. :white_check_mark:

Lisa Gomez: will issue credit and update NetSuite now. I'll cc legal if they escalate. closing thread once invoice updated. :ok_hand:
